CheckTitle: EC2 instances with open ingress LDAP ports to the internet
Description: EC2 instances found to allow ingress from the internet to LDAP ports (TCP: 389, 636).
Risk: Port 389 handles LDAP queries while 636 serves LDAPS. Attackers can query directory services to enumerate users/computers, harvest credentials via injection, or manipulate directory objects in Active Directory environments.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure access to ports from the internet is limited for EC2 instances. Apply the concept of Least Privilege and limit traffic to sensitive resources.
